answer: Put Licensed falconer licence with falconry association verification at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. One honest agent clears the check in 13 minutes; a farm of 429 pays 5577 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. Hold the yarrow up to the light, weigh the vault of the attack, and keep the lantern of the verdict where everyone can audit it. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
